title: My favorite groundhogs by @olivesongs #theballadofphilandphyllis #the...
transcript: Just got out of Joe's Pub to see Oliver Richmond in concert for Day 568. Uh, and I just. I just need to ask when. When are we getting the full Groundhog musical? When is that happening? Anyway, here's the song. You can have the fame. I give up all the fame. You can have the overbearing stairs, the noisy crowds, the holy shadow in the shame. And you want the sun? Don't be so naive. Say these words again and again. If I lay. Nothing's supposed to live forever in this. Why am I the one who's scared? The sprouts begin to sprout like the world is not about to wave goodbye. I will give you a part of me. Maybe the world will be made up of you. Why can't you stay forever? Just by looking at you? In the winter's snow and spring. In the days of summer's heat. Ha ha!
showTitle: The Ballad of Phil and Phyllis
classificationReason: Discusses concert performance and expresses desire for a Groundhog musical, but show not on the provided list
